item.title: Latest on Crystalbrook Aurora
item.description: Crystalbrook Collection’s first development in the ACT, Crystalbrook Aurora, has topped out and confirmed its local dining partner ahead of its early 2027 opening. The post Latest on Crystalbrook Aurora appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Wyndham Resort Torquay’s coastal charm

item.title: Hyatt seals new F1 partnership
item.description: World of Hyatt has become the official hospitality partner of the new Audi Revolut F1 Team, uniting two global brands. The post Hyatt seals new F1 partnership appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: AHICE South East Asia set for record crowd as stellar global speaker line-up grows
item.description: The fourth annual Asia Hotel Industry Conference and Exhibition South East Asia edition (AHICE South East Asia) is shaping up to be held in front of a record crowd, with over 600 delegates including 150 speakers from across the globe set to attend the event at Pan Pacific Singapore on March 10-11, 2026. The post AHICE South East Asia set for record crowd as stellar global speaker line-up grows appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Hilton records full-year net unit growth of over six per cent on back of global demand
item.description: Hilton has reported another phenomenal year of growth, with the company adding nearly 800 hotels and 100,000 new rooms to its global portfolio in 2025, representing full-year net unit growth of 6.7%. The post Hilton records full-year net unit growth of over six per cent on back of global demand appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Marriott’s CEO Capuano says 2025 was a ‘defining’ year for the global chain
item.description: Marriott International President and CEO, Anthony Capuano, says 2025 was a monumental year for the company on the back of solid global growth. The post Marriott’s CEO Capuano says 2025 was a ‘defining’ year for the global chain appeared first on Hotel Management.
